descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Cyber Ninja: Tokyo Rumble is a high-speed VR ninja action game set across multiple eras of Japan. Wield blades, unleash devastating energy techniques, and battle robotic armies in immersive arenas.

# Dynamic Japanese Battlefields
[media]
Fight across Japanese sandbox stages inspired by different eras, from Sengoku castles to modern city streets. Explore freely to discover weapons and skill orbs that give you an edge in battle.

# Skill-Based Combat and Weapon Variety
[media]
Master skill-based combat with precise parries that create openings for fast counterattacks. Ignite your weapons to unleash devastating strikes using swords, axes, rapiers, and more.

# Devastating Energy Techniques
[media]
Use intuitive finger movements to form hand seals and activate powerful techniques, from lightning strikes to plasma blasts and sweeping energy waves that overwhelm groups of enemies.

# Customizable Combat Style
[media]
Equip weapons and energy abilities to match your strategy. Adapt your loadout to counter enemy types and refine your unique ninja fighting style.

Sharpen your skills, adapt your strategy, and rise as the ultimate cyber ninja. The battle awaits.
